strings.* El paso 4 (Validación especial) solo a: * Step 4 (Special validation) only applies to activities of high technical demand or specific risk: cliff diving/jumping, rope jumping, bungee jumping and night or technical diving. If your activity is not on this list, you can skip this step.

strings.La Ficha de Participación es el document: The Participation Form is the base document of Nómada Extremo. Collect your personal data, level of experience, relevant physical condition and compliance with the general conditions.
strings.Los formularios digitales de Nómada Extr: Nómada Extremo digital forms streamline the administrative and validation part. They do not replace human contact: they complement it. You will always have the team available for any questions.
strings.Los formularios enlazados son demostrati: The linked forms are demonstrative. Do not enter real medical data or sensitive personal information. Nómada Extremo is not currently operational as a company and does not carry out any real activities.

strings.Para barranquismo seco y acuático, rafti: For dry and water canyoning, rafting, coasteering and technical kayaking. Physical condition and aptitude in running water or rough sea environments.
strings.Para bautismo de buceo, buceo guiado, sn: For first-time diving, guided diving, adventure snorkeling and certification courses (Open Water, Advanced, Rescue). Medical declaration and underwater fitness.
strings.Para BTT técnico, cicloturismo de aventu: For technical mountain biking, adventure cycle tourism and combined experiences that include cycling. Technical level, protection equipment and management of irregular terrain.
strings.Para escalada deportiva y clásica, vías: For sport and classic climbing, via ferrata, rappelling and caving. Use of specific material, heights and rock environments. Declaration of vertigo if applicable.
strings.Para inmersiones nocturnas y modalidades: For night dives and technical diving modalities. Requires at least active Open Water certification, appropriate lighting equipment, and validation by instructor Diving instructor.
strings.Para montañismo técnico, vivac, bushcraf: For technical mountaineering, bivouac, bushcraft and multi-day expeditions. Personal material, physical condition for prolonged effort and aptitude for remote environments.
strings.Para paracaidismo (tándem y AFF), parape: For skydiving (tandem and AFF), paragliding (tandem and initiation), paramotor and paratrike. Includes declaration of medical fitness and recognition of meteorological conditions.
